hypothesis: H1: the production SPY ribbon_ride signal, executed at 1-2 DTE in a SEPARATE paper account through the weekly-1 machinery (never the SPY core arms, per J's 2026-08-18 directive in project_weekly_options_expansion_2026_08_18.md), has OOS expectancy >= 1.5x the 0DTE arm's over the same sessions, net of a DTE-aware cost model.

the_spec.signal: production SPY ribbon_ride (the live-arm directional signal), NOT the vwap_continuation proxy used in the 07-07 DTE study -- ribbon_ride is what would actually run in the weekly-1 machinery per WEEKLY-OPTIONS-PROGRAM.md
the_spec.execution_venue: weekly-1 lane machinery (automation/state/weekly/params.json), a SEPARATE paper account -- never safe-2/bold-2/any SPY core arm
the_spec.dte_arm: 1-2 DTE only (3-4 DTE is killed per candidate's own null-failure result above -- out of scope for this hypothesis)
the_spec.cost_model_fix_required_first: multiday_dte_compare.py's dependency backtest/autoresearch/_dte_expansion_sim.py hardcodes DEFAULT_ENTRY_SLIPPAGE = 0.02 and DEFAULT_EXIT_SLIPPAGE = 0.02 (both 'byte-for-byte simulator_real.DEFAULT_ENTRY_SLIPPAGE/EXIT_SLIPPAGE') flat across ALL DTE buckets 0-4. This is the single change that must land before any 1-2 DTE go/no-go number is trusted: replace the flat $0.02 with a DTE-AWARE slippage figure measured from REAL Alpaca option quotes, not assumed. Measurement method ($0 cost): for a sample of SPY 1-2 DTE contracts (ITM-2, matching the candidate's fixed config), pull mcp__alpaca__get_option_latest_quote (or get_option_chain) bid/ask at 09:35 ET and again at 10:00 ET across >=20 real trading sessions; compute per-DTE median (ask-bid)/2 as the effective one-way slippage and use that in place of the flat 0.02 for entry AND exit legs. This directly answers the candidate's own disclosure #4 caveat ('flat $0.02 slippage across DTE understates weekly spreads') with a measured number instead of an assumption.
the_spec.sub_window_test_for_the_regime_claim: Re-run multiday_dte_compare.py's 1-2 DTE buckets split into two sub-windows: 2026-03-01..2026-06-30 (the window named in the UNVERIFIED claim) vs the remainder of the existing window (2025-01-02..2026-06-16 minus that slice). Compute OOS exp/tr, WR, and the random-entry-null p-value independently for each sub-window at 1DTE and 2DTE. This directly tests whether the 2DTE null failure (p=0.0647) and the two cited losing quarters are real regime-dependence or an artifact of the stage-1 draft's methodology (which this session could not verify against a primary script output).

n_needed: From the 07-07 candidate's own OOS counts: 1DTE oos_n=166 (full) / 51 (2026 OOS split), 2DTE oos_n=165 (full) / 50 (2026 OOS split). This prereg requires the SAME order of magnitude on the weekly-1-lane forward data: n>=15 forward round trips minimum (matching this project's standing evidence_n advisory bar per CLAUDE.md OP-11), with n>=20 scored trading days as the PRIMARY bar (matching the go-live-gate.py bar quoted in CLAUDE.md 'Live threshold' section: 'bootstrap CI-lower(2.5%) > 1.0 ... over >=20 scored trading days'). Below n=20, any result stays labeled UNVERIFIED -- insufficient n, not a negative finding (same convention as prereg-vix-bull-hard-cap-unblock-shadow-2026-09-05.json's extend_criterion).

ex_best_day_and_bh_fdr_bars.ex_best_day: Per CLAUDE.md's go-live gate definition (measured by setup/scripts/go_live_gate.py): the >=1.5x lift claim must hold on an EX-BEST-DAY basis -- drop the single best-P&L trading day from both the 1-2DTE weekly-lane sample and the 0DTE comparison sample, then recompute the ratio. If the lift only clears 1.5x WITH the best day included, that is a concentration artifact (per OP-19 / BACKTESTING-PLAYBOOK.md 2.4 'Single-metric reporting' anti-pattern) and the hypothesis is NOT supported.
ex_best_day_and_bh_fdr_bars.bh_fdr: Every additional cut this prereg proposes (the two DTE arms x the two sub-windows x cost-model-adjusted vs raw) multiplies the number of hypothesis tests run against the same underlying data. Per this project's standing multiple-comparisons discipline (OP 16/20, BACKTESTING-PLAYBOOK.md 5-stage grinder + validation stack), apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across the full set of p-values produced (random-entry-null p per DTE-arm per sub-window) before calling any individual cell significant at the nominal p<0.05 threshold used in the candidate's original result table.

kill_criteria.primary_kill: If, after the DTE-aware cost-model fix is applied, 1-2 DTE weekly-lane OOS expectancy does NOT beat the 0DTE arm's OOS expectancy over the same sessions by >= 1.5x (ex-best-day, cost-adjusted, bootstrap CI-lower(2.5%) basis) at n>=20 scored trading days, the candidate is KILLED and this file's candidate is closed.
kill_criteria.sub_window_kill: If the 2026-03..06 sub-window test confirms the UNVERIFIED regime claim (2DTE random-null fails to clear p<0.05 in that window AND the two cited quarters are confirmed net-negative from a primary run, not a re-quote of an unverifiable draft), the candidate is KILLED regardless of the aggregate-window result -- a signal that only works ex-regime is not a standing edge per BACKTESTING-PLAYBOOK.md 1.4 ('the strategy is regime-fragile always; discover the regime sensitivity before live trading, not after').
kill_criteria.either_kill_closes_the_candidate: Either failure alone is sufficient to kill; both must pass to proceed to a 2026-10-30 checkpoint SHADOW-FILE proposal.
